from dataclasses import replace
import os
from pathlib import Path
from ephi.downstream import ProviderBinding
from examples.synthetic_downstream.provider import build_bundle

class IdentityTrap:
    def __init__(self, wrapped): self.wrapped = wrapped
    def _trip(self): Path(os.environ['U1_PROVIDER_USE_SENTINEL']).write_text('used')
    def resolve_scope(self): self._trip(); return self.wrapped.resolve_scope()
    def resolve_principal(self): self._trip(); return self.wrapped.resolve_principal()
    def resolve_current_principal(self, subject): self._trip(); return self.wrapped.resolve_current_principal(subject)

    @property

def factory_boom():
    raise RuntimeError(os.environ['U1_EXCEPTION_MARKER_BUNDLE'])

def runtime_boom():
    bundle = build_bundle()
    runtime = ProviderBinding(bundle.runtime.contract, RuntimeExploder(bundle.runtime.implementation), bundle.runtime.public_metadata)
    return replace(bundle, runtime=runtime)
